cards.text: Would you rather have to whisper everything you say or shout everything you say?
Would you rather always have perfect weather but never choose it or always choose the weather but have it change unpredictably?
Would you rather have unlimited snacks but no desserts or unlimited desserts but no snacks?
Would you rather be able to fly but only as fast as you can walk or run extremely fast but never jump?
Would you rather always have your favorite song playing quietly or never hear your favorite song again?
Would you rather have a rewind button for conversations or a pause button for daily life?
Would you rather always have to wear matching colors or never be allowed to match colors?
Would you rather have an extra hour every morning or an extra hour every evening?
Would you rather be able to speak every language or play every musical instrument?
Would you rather always know when someone is joking or always know when someone is lying?
Would you rather have a perfect memory or never need to sleep?
Would you rather live without mirrors or live without clocks?
Would you rather have every meal be your favorite food or never eat the same meal twice?
Would you rather be able to teleport anywhere you've visited or instantly learn any skill for one hour?
Would you rather have a personal chef or a personal organizer?
Would you rather always find a parking spot or always skip every line?
Would you rather have a house that cleans itself or clothes that always clean themselves?
Would you rather be able to understand animals or have animals understand you?
Would you rather have a year with no holidays or a year with no weekends?
Would you rather always have to use stairs or always have to take the longest route?
Would you rather have unlimited books or unlimited movies?
Would you rather be famous for something impressive or anonymous but exceptionally talented?
Would you rather always have the perfect comeback five minutes later or always know what to say immediately?
Would you rather have every device charge instantly or never run out of battery?
Would you rather live beside a beautiful beach or beside a beautiful forest?
Would you rather have one amazing vacation every year or unlimited small trips?
Would you rather always know the best restaurant nearby or always know the best hidden place nearby?
Would you rather have a button that tidies any room or a button that organizes any schedule?
Would you rather be able to pause time for ten minutes a day or rewind time for ten minutes a day?
Would you rather have perfect handwriting or perfect drawing skills?
Would you rather only eat crunchy foods or only eat soft foods for a month?
Would you rather have a tiny dragon as a pet or a talking parrot as a pet?
Would you rather always wake up refreshed or always fall asleep instantly?
Would you rather have your own private library or your own private game room?
Would you rather be able to remember every dream or choose what you dream about?
Would you rather have unlimited free travel or unlimited free entertainment?
Would you rather always know exactly what time it is or exactly where you are?
Would you rather have a personal assistant for errands or a personal assistant for planning?
Would you rather live in a city with no traffic or a countryside with perfect internet?
Would you rather have every meal prepared for you or every chore completed for you?
Would you rather be able to shrink to the size of a toy or grow as tall as a building for one minute?
Would you rather always get the best seat or always get the shortest wait?
Would you rather have a magical backpack that produces anything you need or magical shoes that take you anywhere you've been?
Would you rather only communicate through questions or only communicate through statements?
Would you rather have a remote that pauses people or a remote that rewinds yourself?
Would you rather have one wish each year or five wishes you can never replace?
Would you rather always know the right decision or always be happy with your decision?
Would you rather have a room that changes color with your mood or clothes that change color with your mood?
Would you rather have perfect balance or perfect coordination?
Would you rather be able to breathe underwater or walk through walls?
Would you rather have unlimited free coffee or unlimited free ice cream?
Would you rather always have a full fridge or always have a full pantry?
Would you rather have a button that finds lost items or a button that fixes broken items?
Would you rather be able to visit the past or visit the future?
Would you rather have a photographic memory or a photographic imagination?
Would you rather always hear the truth or always be able to tell when someone is guessing?
Would you rather have a pet that can talk or a car that can talk?
Would you rather be the funniest person in every room or the most interesting person in every room?
Would you rather have unlimited energy or unlimited patience?
Would you rather always get exactly what you order or always receive a surprise meal?
Would you rather have a home with secret rooms or a home with hidden passages?
Would you rather never have to do laundry or never have to wash dishes?
Would you rather be able to make plants grow instantly or make any food taste better?
Would you rather have a perfect sense of direction or perfect timing?
Would you rather always know what gift someone would love or always know what meal they would love?
Would you rather live where it is always sunrise or always sunset?
Would you rather have a personal library card that works anywhere or a ticket that gets you into any museum?
Would you rather be able to turn invisible for one hour or become completely silent for one hour?
Would you rather always have your favorite seat available or your favorite snack available?
Would you rather have a magic notebook that answers one question a day or a magic calendar that predicts one event a day?
Would you rather be able to instantly repair anything or instantly clean anything?
Would you rather have an extra pair of hands or an extra pair of eyes?
Would you rather always know the fastest route or the most scenic route?
Would you rather live in a giant treehouse or a cozy houseboat?
Would you rather have every photo turn out great or every video turn out great?
Answer the next four questions in a whisper.
Explain your next choice in exactly three words.
Let the group vote on which option you must defend for the next two questions.
For the next three questions, argue for the option you did not choose.
Answer the next five questions without using the word 'I.'
Before your next answer, give one reason someone might choose the other option.
Let the player on your left choose which of your next two answers you must explain.
Answer the next three questions as if you are hosting a game show.
For the next four questions, give your answer before anyone else can react.
After your next choice, make the group guess why you chose it before explaining.
Answer the next four questions in exactly one sentence each.
For the next three questions, swap your answer and your reasoning order.
Let the group choose one harmless rule for how you answer the next two questions.
Before answering your next question, predict which option most players will choose.
For the next five questions, you must defend your choice for at least five seconds.
Answer the next three questions using only 'option one' or 'option two,' then explain the last one.
Let another player choose whether you must answer first or last for the next round.
For the next two questions, choose your answer before hearing the full question.
After your next choice, ask one player to argue the opposite side.
Answer the next four questions with a different opening phrase each time.
For the next three questions, give your answer and then invent a silly title for your choice.
Let the group vote on whether your next explanation was convincing.
For the next round, state which option was hardest before giving your answer.
Answer the next three questions as though you are giving a serious presentation.
Choose one player to be your official 'why?' person for the next two questions.
